title: Your Mercury sign = how you text
caption: Paragraphs, one-word replies, voice notes at midnight: blame (or thank) your Mercury sign.

beats.head: Your *Mercury* sign is how you text.
Fun fact: it always stays *close* to your Sun.
beats.sub: Your Mercury is in your Sun sign, or one right next to it.

beats.head: Fire Mercury texts *fast.*
beats.sub: Aries, Leo, Sagittarius: caps lock, voice notes, replies in seconds.

beats.head: Earth Mercury texts *on purpose.*
beats.sub: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn: full sentences, clear plans, real punctuation.

beats.head: Air Mercury texts in *paragraphs.*
beats.sub: Gemini, Libra, Aquarius: three topics at once, plus a follow-up question.

beats.head: Water Mercury texts the *vibe.*
beats.sub: Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces: they read your tone, and the pause before it.

beats.head: Different *styles,* not bad intentions.
beats.sub: A short reply isn't always a cold one.

beats.head: Ask how they like to *talk.*
beats.sub: Calls, texts or voice notes. Then meet in the middle.
